'''Aviellin''' is a ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' of an unknown clan and sept. 

== Activities ==
She is part of [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army that goes into [[Ghealdan]].

She is gravely injured while taking out the [[Shaido]] sentries around [[Malden]] and has to be [[Heal]]ed by [[Janina]].
